meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aWoiw0KHlTJUYAk1x_playbook
title: Flow 1
actions:
  Configuration:
    title: Configuration
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Initializes workflow variables for observable type filtering and stores the observables array for processing.
    on-success:
    - Analyze_Observables: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Observable_Types_to_Enrich
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.Observable_Types_to_Enrich
    - name: Observables_Array
      value: {}
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 880ca54d-6425-4e4a-8b2c-9b87d7065447
    outputSchemaReferenceId: cfe5da95-1bf2-40c0-a31b-c03ee1b2f711
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Analyze_Observables:
    title: Analyze Observables
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Determines the format and validity of input observables (string, array, empty, or invalid) and counts valid observable entries.
    on-success:
    - Parallel: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      observables_property_analysis:
        title: Observables Property Analysis
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: "(\n    $oo := inputs.TEDS_Object.observables ;\n    \n    $raw_type := $type($oo) ;\n\n    $real_type := ($raw_type = \"array\" and $count($oo) = 0) ? \"empty_array\"\n               :  ($raw_type = \"array\" and $count($oo) = $count($oo[observable_type and observable_value])) ? \"valid_array\"\n               :  ($raw_type = \"array\" and $not($count($oo) = $count($oo[observable_type and observable_value]))) ? \"invalid_array\"\n               :  ($raw_type = \"string\" and $length($oo) = 0) ? \"empty_string\"\n               :  ($raw_type = \"string\" and $length($oo) > 0) ? \"valid_string\" \n               : \"invalid_object\" ;\n\n\n\n    $o_count :=  ($real_type = \"valid_string\") ? -1 /* Unknown but must run through Parse IOCs */\n               : ($real_type = \"empty_string\") ? 0 /* Do not run through Parse IOCs */\n               : ($real_type = \"valid_array\") ? $count($oo) /* Get real count of valid array objects */\n               : ($real_type = \"invalid_array\") ? -1 /* Unknown */\n               : ($real_type = \"empty_array\") ? 0 /* No valid objects in array */\n               : -1 ; /* Unknown for Invalid object */\n\n    $ret := {\n        \"observable_object_type\": $real_type,\n        \"observables_count\": $o_count\n    } ;\n\n)"
          data:
            inputs:
              TEDS_Object:
                observables:
                  $:ref: $inputs.TEDS_Object.observables
        actionType: jsonata
        next: observable_object_type
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      observable_object_type:
        title: Observable Object Type
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: actions.Analyze_Observables.result.observables_property_analysis.observable_object_type
          data:
            actions:
              Analyze_Observables:
                result:
                  observables_property_analysis:
                    $:ref: $actions.Analyze_Observables.result.observables_property_analysis
        actionType: jsonata
        next: observables_count
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      observables_count:
        title: Observables Count
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: actions.Analyze_Observables.result.observables_property_analysis.observables_count
          data:
            actions:
              Analyze_Observables:
                result:
                  observables_property_analysis:
                    $:ref: $actions.Analyze_Observables.result.observables_property_analysis
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: observables_property_analysis
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Parallel:
    title: Parallel
    type: parallelGroup
    description: >
      Executes multiple processing branches simultaneously based on observable format type detected in analysis phase.
    on-success:
    - Merge_TEDS_Object: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - If_Observables_Count_eq_0
    actions:
      If_Valid_String:
        title: If Valid String
        type: conditional
        description: >
          Routes flow to parse observables when input format is detected as a valid string containing IOC data.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        conditions:
        - action: Parse_Observables
          condition:
            $:and:
            - - $:ref: $actions.Analyze_Observables.result.observable_object_type
              - $:eq: valid_string
              - ignoreCase: true
        else: If_Valid_Array
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 9b2c9170-7d40-40e9-9d13-1da51824919e
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      If_Valid_Array:
        title: If Valid Array
        type: conditional
        description: >
          Routes flow to filter observables when input format is a properly structured array of observable objects.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        conditions:
        - action: Filter_Allowed_Observable_Types
          condition:
            $:and:
            - - $:ref: $actions.Analyze_Observables.result.observable_object_type
              - $:eq: valid_array
              - ignoreCase: true
        else: If_Invalid_Array_Object
        inputSchemaReferenceId: ddb36fba-708b-4ed6-9cf0-030da1cb47f7
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Parse_Observables:
        title: Parse Observables
        type: connector
        description: >
          Extracts and structures IOCs from free-text string input into standardized observable objects.
        on-success:
        - Update_Observables_with_Parsed_Observables: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_aWUmHOqW3cVzrMZTh_playbook
        inputs:
          text_value: '{ $:ref: $inputs.TEDS_Object.observables }'
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
      Update_Observables_with_Parsed_Observables:
        title: Update Observables with Parsed Observables
        type: updateVariables
        description: >
          Sets the Observables_Array variable with the parsed observable objects from string input.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: Observables_Array
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Parse_Observables.result.published.observables
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 7e990081-8aa4-4a07-acd0-1f46f446e764
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 72d6d7d1-fdfb-4082-976e-06a98317221a
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Stringify_Invalid_Objects:
        title: Stringify Invalid Objects
        type: transformation
        description: >
          Converts invalid or malformed observable objects to JSON string format for reprocessing.
        on-success:
        - Parse_Observables_from_Invalid_Object: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        transformations:
          stringified_object:
            title: Stringified Object
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: $string(inputs.TEDS_Object.observables, true)
              data:
                inputs:
                  TEDS_Object:
                    observables:
                      $:ref: $inputs.TEDS_Object.observables
            actionType: jsonata
            next: ""
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
        entrypoint: stringified_object
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      If_Observables_Count_eq_0:
        meta: {}
        title: If Observables Count eq 0
        type: conditional
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Checks whether any observables exist to process; continues to format detection if count is non-zero.
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 5cc1de8c-71d6-4bac-b7a8-581bb170061e
        conditions:
        - action: If_Valid_String
          condition:
            $:and:
            - - $:ref: $actions.Analyze_Observables.result.observables_count
              - $:neq: 0
        else: ""
      If_Invalid_Array_Object:
        meta: {}
        title: If Invalid Array/Object
        type: conditional
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: >
          Routes flow to stringify and reprocess when observables are in an invalid or malformed data structure.
        inputSchemaReferenceId: e192bded-d451-4b7b-b241-c8441b379c40
        conditions:
        - action: Stringify_Invalid_Objects
          condition:
            $:and:
            - $:or:
              - - $:ref: $actions.Analyze_Observables.result.observable_object_type
                - $:eq: invalid_array
                - ignoreCase: true
              - - $:ref: $actions.Analyze_Observables.result.observable_object_type
                - $:eq: invalid_object
                - ignoreCase: true
        else: ""
      Parse_Observables_from_Invalid_Object:
        title: Parse Observables from Invalid Object
        type: connector
        description: >
          Extracts IOCs from the stringified invalid object and converts them to structured observable format.
        on-success:
        - Update_Observables_from_Parsed_Observables_2: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_aWUmHOqW3cVzrMZTh_playbook
        inputs:
          text_value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Stringify_Invalid_Objects.result.stringified_object }'
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
      Update_Observables_from_Parsed_Observables_2:
        title: Update Observables from Parsed Observables 2
        type: updateVariables
        description: >
          Sets the Observables_Array variable with observables parsed from the stringified invalid object.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: Observables_Array
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Parse_Observables_from_Invalid_Object.result.published.observables
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 618e3f8a-0b6a-4629-ae5b-d95de5294050
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 08646237-3d61-4a8f-9444-e038802c6430
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Update_Observables_with_Filtered_Array:
        title: Update Observables with Filtered Array
        type: updateVariables
        description: >
          Sets the Observables_Array variable with observables filtered by configured allowed types.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: Observables_Array
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Filter_Allowed_Observable_Types.result.filtered_observables_array
        inputSchemaReferenceId: d6120f3a-e9e5-4a2e-9af2-686c1d4fb203
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 775edd88-ef15-473c-8214-5bc23dd55219
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Filter_Allowed_Observable_Types:
        title: Filter Allowed Observable Types
        type: transformation
        description: >
          Filters observable array to include only types specified in the configuration (e.g., IP, domain, hash).
        on-success:
        - Update_Observables_with_Filtered_Array: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        transformations:
          filtered_observables_array:
            title: Filtered Observables Array
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: "(\n    $raw := inputs.TEDS_Object.observables ;\n    $types := variables.Observable_Types_to_Enrich ;\n    \n    $obs := $raw[observable_type in $types] ;\n\n    $distinct([$obs]) ;\n)"
              data:
                inputs:
                  TEDS_Object:
                    observables:
                      $:ref: $inputs.TEDS_Object.observables
                variables:
                  Observable_Types_to_Enrich:
                    $:ref: $variables.Observable_Types_to_Enrich
            actionType: jsonata
            next: ""
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
        entrypoint: filtered_observables_array
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Merge_TEDS_Object:
    title: Merge TEDS Object
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Combines the original TEDS object with the processed observables array to create the final output.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      teds_object:
        title: TEDS Object
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: >-
            (
                $raw_teds_object := inputs.TEDS_Object ;
                $new_teds_observables := variables.Observables_Array ;


                $new_teds_object := $merge([$raw_teds_object, { "observables": $new_teds_observables }])

            )
          data:
            inputs:
              TEDS_Object:
                $:ref: $inputs.TEDS_Object
            variables:
              Observables_Array:
                $:ref: $variables.Observables_Array
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: teds_object
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
meta: {}
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Configuration
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  TEDS_Object:
    $:ref: $actions.Merge_TEDS_Object.result.teds_object
environment: {}
triggers: {}
inputSchemaReferenceId: 4c6f1d9a-ff93-4469-bb07-ca1a0f74339f
outputSchemaReferenceId: 90cdb020-a8c8-4538-a9c3-dc2de9d4774d
inputs:
  type: object
publishSchemaReferenceId: f865b0a1-1b29-4fb6-8f8e-3a6b386e2c41
